title: Integrative Genome-Wide Association Study with eQTL Combined with Transcriptome Analysis Reveals SLC18A1 as a Novel Biomarker for Small Cell Lung Cancer.
snippet: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a malignant tumor with low differentiation, high recurrence, and poor prognosis. The importance of SCLC prevention is becoming increasingly apparent.
